get_extension_value: get the current value of a protobuf extension field using the _ExtensionDict __getitem__ method
set_extension_value: set a scalar extension field value on a protobuf message using the _ExtensionDict __setitem__ method
check_extension_presence: check if a protobuf extension field is populated using the _ExtensionDict __contains__ method
find_extension_by_name: find a known extension field descriptor by its full name using _FindExtensionByName
verify_extension_handle: verify that an extension handle is valid for a given protobuf message using _VerifyExtensionHandle
